interface.shortDescription: BloodHound, OpenHound, and SCIM attack-path workflows.
interface.longDescription: Focused workflows for BloodHound AD/ADCS, AzureHound/Entra ID, GitHound/OpenHound GitHub, JamfHound/OpenHound Jamf, OktaHound/OpenHound Okta, SCIM bridge analysis, saved-query adaptation, collector-aware references, and optional BloodHound MCP-assisted graph analysis.
defaultPrompt: Use BloodHound Analysis to triage an AD or ADCS attack path.
Use AzureHound to analyze Entra ID and Azure privilege paths.
Use OpenHound GitHub/Jamf/Okta workflows with SCIM references to adapt saved queries for OpenGraph attack-path analysis.
